body.heading: Where in the world is Georgia?
paragraphs: Georgia is a country in Western Asia, which is part of Asia.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Georgia is Tbilisi.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Georgia is Georgian.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Georgia is the Georgian lari.

body.heading: How big is Georgia?
paragraphs: Georgia covers about 70,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Tajikistan.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Tbilisi's old town is a jumble of colourful balconies, sulphur bathhouses and narrow lanes beneath the ancient Narikala Fortress and the Mtkvari River cliffs.
At Stepantsminda, the Gergeti Trinity Church stands on a green hill before the snowy cone of Mount Kazbek — one of the most photographed views in the Caucasus.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Georgia on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
